title: Your first week
pick: Pick your role for a short first-week playbook: the steps that matter most, each linking to where you do it.
askAssistant: Ask the assistant to walk me through it
askPrompt:
Walk me through the VoC first-week playbook for the {{role}} role, one step at a time. For each step, tell me why it matters, show me what it looks like with our own feedback, and where in the app I finish it. Ask before you change anything. The steps:
{{stepList}}

product.name: Product manager
product.desc: Turn what customers say into personas, PR/FAQs and PRDs.

scrum_master.name: Scrum master
scrum_master.desc: Bring customer evidence to planning, reviews and retrospectives.

qa.name: QA
qa.desc: Test forms, find the feedback behind bugs and watch releases.

engineering.name: Engineering
engineering.desc: Connect a repository and turn problems into reviewed changes.

read_dashboard.title: Read this week's dashboard
read_dashboard.why: Volume, sentiment and the top categories show where to look first.

generate_personas.title: Generate personas from real feedback
generate_personas.why: Personas grounded in reviews keep decisions about real customers.

write_document.title: Draft a PR/FAQ or a PRD
write_document.why: Writing it down from the evidence makes the case for the work.

set_objectives.title: Set your objectives and KPIs
set_objectives.why: The assistant and the brief weigh feedback against what you are measured on.

subscribe_brief.title: Subscribe to the morning brief
subscribe_brief.why: What changed overnight reaches you without opening the app.

review_problems.title: Review the problems customers report most
review_problems.why: The ranked problems tell you what to plan, fix or test first.

share_project.title: Share the project with your team
share_project.why: Everyone plans from the same evidence.

create_form.title: Create a feedback form
create_form.why: A form asks the questions your team needs answered, in nine languages.

read_form_results.title: Read a form's results and report
read_form_results.why: The report gives you the themes and quotes to bring to the retrospective.

test_form.title: Test a form with its test link
test_form.why: A test response checks the questions and the logic without counting in any result.

search_feedback.title: Find the feedback behind an issue
search_feedback.why: The customers' own words show how a bug or a gap is felt.

watch_release.title: Watch the feedback after a release
watch_release.why: A change in volume or sentiment after a release points at a regression.

connect_repository.title: Connect a repository
connect_repository.why: The engineering agents can then turn a problem into a pull request.

run_engineering_agent.title: Start an engineering run from a problem
run_engineering_agent.why: An agent builds the fix, and a person reviews it before anything is pushed.

build_prototype.title: Build a prototype from a PRD
build_prototype.why: A clickable prototype is tested with customers before it is built for real.

connect_mcp.title: Use VoC from your IDE
connect_mcp.why: Your coding assistant reads the same feedback through one MCP endpoint.
